t: This one is a period rather than a spot on the map. The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland was created by the Acts of Union in 1801 and lasted until 1922. Several notable people lived in London during it. Florence Nightingale, founder of modern nursing, was one. Henry Cavendish, who discovered hydrogen, was another. The painter James McNeill Whistler, the inventor Charles Wheatstone and the mathematician Edward Routh also lived here. Robert Bulwer-Lytton was born in this kingdom, and was Viceroy of India while Queen Victoria was proclaimed Empress of India.
